ranked_audit_findings.title: vin/experimental is a dependency trap, not an experiment
evidence: experimental/model.py has zero importers in the audit.
model_v1_SH.py is kept alive only by tests/test_config_field_constraints.py.
Load-bearing VinForwardDiagnostics, plotting builders, and FIELD_CHANNELS_V2 were hidden under experimental surfaces.
ranked_audit_findings.claude_recommendation: Delete dead models, promote used diagnostics/types/plotting into vin proper, and remove the misleading experimental package name.
ranked_audit_findings.reconciled_status: Mostly resolved or changed by codex/vin-cleanup-pr15-integration; keep remaining v2 lineage quarantine and naming cleanup as follow-up.

ranked_audit_findings.title: Target-RRI scorer duplicates the scene oracle-RRI scorer
evidence: CounterfactualTargetOracleRriScorer duplicates CounterfactualOracleRriScorer config fields, root-eval caching, render/backproject/fuse/score skeleton.
A third offline labeler path exists in pipelines/oracle_rri_labeler.py.
ranked_audit_findings.claude_recommendation: Unify under one scorer base parameterized by an eval-region policy: scene extent versus GT-OBB target crop.
ranked_audit_findings.reconciled_status: High-leverage follow-up after the counterfactual modules move into rollouts; lock behavior first with rollout/counterfactual tests.

ranked_audit_findings.title: rollouts/zarr_store.py hand-rolls a columnar table engine
evidence: _TableSchema exists but table append/write/read/validate paths remain bespoke.
Adding one replay field can require changes across multiple empty/append/rows_to_numpy/read/write functions.
Q_H derivation appears in writer, reader view, and validator.
ranked_audit_findings.claude_recommendation: Finish schema-driven table append/write/read/validate and centralize Q_H derivation without changing on-disk format.
ranked_audit_findings.reconciled_status: Defer until after the ownership move; preserve existing store compatibility and validator behavior.

ranked_audit_findings.title: Frustum and CW90 geometry are duplicated across multiple modules
evidence: Frustum corners/segments appear in utils/data_plotting.py, rerun_inspector/_frusta.py, vin utilities/mixins, and rendering/plotting.py.
CW90 handling is split across utils/frames.py and display/rendering/viewer code.
model_v3._forward_impl used an implicit p3d_cameras.cw90_corrected getattr protocol in the audited tree.
ranked_audit_findings.claude_recommendation: Create a single geometry owner for frustum vertices and display-rotation contracts; replace monkey-patched camera flags with an explicit typed camera wrapper.
ranked_audit_findings.reconciled_status: Defer to a geometry-specific phase and consult nbv-geometry-contracts before edits.

ranked_audit_findings.title: Rollout read-side diagnostics are implemented in parallel stacks
evidence: rollouts/inspection.py, rerun_inspector/_rollout_zarr.py, app/panels/stored_rollouts.py, and app/panels/counterfactual_rollouts.py independently summarize RolloutZarrStoreReader rows.
Typed payload classes in rerun_inspector/_rollout_zarr.py are a likely seed for a shared read model.
ranked_audit_findings.claude_recommendation: Promote one typed rollout read model consumed by Rerun and Streamlit, keeping panels UI-only.
ranked_audit_findings.reconciled_status: Defer; extract only helpers directly adjacent to the counterfactual ownership move.

ranked_audit_findings.title: VIN forward and Lightning training paths contain god methods
evidence: VinModelV3._forward_impl is a long multi-stage method with lazy backbone initialization and forward-time device mutation in the audited tree.
VinLightningModule._step mixes loss, masking, coverage weighting, CORAL variants, logging, plotting, and summaries.
ranked_audit_findings.claude_recommendation: Extract pure objective/loss helpers and diagnostics helpers so Lightning is a thin adapter; keep numerics locked by seeded tests.
ranked_audit_findings.reconciled_status: Defer broad decomposition; related PR15 finding-validity plan prioritizes correctness fixes for checkpoint lifecycle, metric aggregation, and forward-time mutation before layout changes.

ranked_audit_findings.title: Smaller cleanup wins remain available
evidence: 101 broad except Exception sites, including rollouts/inspection.py concentration.
rl/ is active but post-M6 in roadmap and wired into app/config.py.
72 config classes redeclare target_type.
Seven DTO .to(device) methods duplicate tensor-container behavior.
utils/summary.py overlaps utils/rich_summary.py.
_target_selection.py is high-churn and mixes DTOs, selector classes, and geometry/scoring helpers.
ranked_audit_findings.claude_recommendation: Handle these as phase-local simplifications after higher-risk seams are locked, with explicit tests and debriefs.
ranked_audit_findings.reconciled_status: Mostly follow-up; do not fold broad RL, target-selection, config, or utility restructuring into the immediate counterfactual move.
